features.description: Integration ActionItem catalog: declare the operator-owned integration steps (Firebase functions deploy, Firebase realtime smoke, static-dashboard smoke, Linear credential setup, Discord webhook setup) as ActionItems produced by a new provide_integration_actions() source in operator_console.py with its own SOURCE_INTEGRATION source kind, each carrying what/why/credentials_required/exact_command/evidence_expected/reversible plus the shipped control-plane spine fields (audience, dedupe_key, plain_consequence, clears_when, resolution_class). Data + projection, not credential handling.
steps: Enumerate the known operator integration steps; record external commands as operator_command (display-only), validated dontpanic commands as exact_command, None otherwise
Model each as an ActionItem (audience=operator, requires_human where creds needed) with spine fields populated
Mark credentials_required + reversible + evidence_expected per item; clears_when points at the integration-evidence contract
Wire provide_integration_actions through the real dashboard aggregation with per-source scope + freshness entries
Dedupe by dedupe_key; no-secret-leak assertion
Fixture tests through the real provider + aggregation path
features.acceptance: provide_integration_actions() emits one ActionItem per integration step through the same source-provider seam as the five shipped providers in operator_console.py, with the new SOURCE_INTEGRATION source kind, AND is wired through the real dashboard aggregation path (the same collect/build/write-cache pipeline the other providers flow through) with its own per-source scope and freshness entries - proven by a test that walks the real build, not a direct provider call alone. Command honesty (resolves the exact_command vocabulary gap): external operator commands (e.g. firebase deploy) are carried in a NEW display-only operator_command catalog field rendered as run-this-yourself copy and never passed through the validated exact_command boundary; exact_command is populated ONLY when a validated dontpanic command exists for the step, else None per the shipped honest-commands rule (producers emit None rather than a command that fails _validate_exact_command_or_raise). Each item populates what/why/credential_env_vars/operator_command-or-exact_command/evidence_expected/reversible from the integration_catalog; resolution_class is RESOLUTION_OPERATOR_ATTESTED or RESOLUTION_BLOCKED_EXTERNAL for credentialed steps (never RESOLUTION_COMMAND_RESOLVABLE for them); clears_when names the integration-evidence file that resolves the item; dedupe_key stable across rebuilds; no secrets in any field. Verified by fixture tests through the real provider + aggregation seams. Serialization round-trip pinned: the new display fields (operator_command, credentials_required, evidence_expected, trigger_condition) are carried by ActionItem.to_dict and survive the shipped normalization chain (triage payload, what-now payload, operator-console rendering) without being dropped, INCLUDING the fleet/project projection rehydration path (fleet aggregation, per-project caches, and rehydration back into the shell) where unknown sources are at risk of being filtered - proven by round-trip tests through each normalizer AND through the fleet projection rehydration. Credential determinism pinned: each catalog entry carries credential_env_vars - the exact, deterministic list of env-var NAMES that step requires (empty list = no credentials); credentials_required is derived from that list being non-empty, and item copy displays the names so the operator knows precisely what to provision; fixture tests assert the per-item name lists. The catalog implements EXACTLY the literal rows pinned in plan.md's catalog table (commands, credential env-var names, action ids, evidence expectations) - fixtures assert those literals.

features.description: Integration evidence writer + entry points: (a) the static-dashboard smoke - a runnable check that `dontpanic state export-dashboard` output actually feeds the real dashboard build (render-proof, not just parse-proof); (b) an operator attestation command for steps whose proof lives outside the repo (deploys, external smokes, credential setups). Both write the same append-only evidence contract. Re-homes the static half of firebase-adapter F005 as an operator action.
steps: Implement write_integration_evidence() - append-only JSONL per integration, mirroring capabilities_setup_evidence sanitization/mode discipline
Implement the static-smoke runner: export-dashboard into a temp dir, run the real dashboard build over it, assert rendered output artifacts
Implement `dontpanic integrations attest` writing attestation records through the same writer
Write passed/failed evidence records; wire smoke as the F001 static-dashboard item's exact_command
Tests: smoke passes + appends on fixture state; fails loudly + records outcome=failed on garbled state; attest round-trips; prior records never rewritten
features.acceptance: Evidence contract: one append-only JSONL file per integration under the DontPanic home integrations evidence directory, records carrying schema_version, the integration identifier, action identifier, captured_at, source (smoke|attestation), outcome (passed or failed), and sanitized details (file mode 0600, dir 0700, secret patterns scrubbed); records are only ever appended via write_integration_evidence() - a later failed record never deletes or rewrites prior records, and these files are the SOLE channel downstream consumers read (the F001 clears_when predicates name them). Render-proof smoke: the smoke is the literal command `dontpanic integrations smoke static-dashboard` (this exact string is the F001 static-dashboard item's exact_command and what the F004 end-to-end test executes); it invokes the real `dontpanic state export-dashboard`, then runs the real dashboard build over the exported state and asserts render-proof markers: the build succeeds AND the state's identifying values appear in the BUILT dashboard artifact itself (the rendered HTML/page output - matching in copied state JSON files does NOT count), so parseable-but-unrenderable or silently-empty renders fail the smoke and record outcome=failed. Attestation capture: `dontpanic integrations attest <integration> --action <action_id> --outcome passed|failed [--note]` records an operator attestation through the same writer - records carry source=attestation plus the action_id they attest (trigger attestations use the integration's declared trigger action_id), so every evidence record is attributable to a specific catalog action and no evidence file is ever hand-edited. Verified by tests over a fixture state dir, including a garbled-state failure case and an attest-then-read round trip.

evidence.notes: write_integration_evidence() append-only JSONL per integration under $DONTPANIC_HOME/integrations/evidence/<id>.jsonl (schema_version/integration_id/action_id/captured_at/source/outcome/sanitized details; 0600/0700; outcome+source validated; traversal-neutralized id; later failed record never rewrites prior). run_static_dashboard_smoke() runs the REAL dashboard.build over an exported state with write_what_now_cache + home-cache redirect, derives expected dedupe_keys via _gather_action_items, and asserts the producer's integration cards reach the BUILT what-now.json (not copied state JSON) - silently-empty/raising builds record outcome=failed (producer-card-fidelity per D008). integrations_cli.integrations_main: `smoke static-dashboard` (exit 0/4) + `attest <integration> --action <id> --outcome passed|failed [--note]` both write through the same writer; cli.py routes `integrations ...` to it. features.description: Gated realtime/deploy actions: represent Firebase functions deploy + realtime smoke (code already shipped+tested in dashboard/functions/) as ActionItems gated on multi-operator need + credentials. Never auto-executes; surfaces the exact command + evidence the operator must capture. Re-homes firebase-adapter F003/F005 realtime half, parked behind its trigger.
steps: Model deploy + realtime-smoke as always-rendered gated ActionItems (requires_human=true, credentials_required=true, operator_command display-only)
Encode trigger_condition as a static catalog field; met only via operator-attested evidence record
Credential presence = presence-only env-var NAME checks; never values, never probes
Reference the shipped dashboard/functions/ + firestore.rules as prerequisites met
Test: items render gated until trigger evidence + creds present; never execute; offline fixtures only
features.acceptance: Firebase deploy + realtime smoke appear as operator ActionItems that ALWAYS render (gating is shown as state, never by hiding the item): each carries its external command in operator_command (display-only; exact_command=None per honest-commands), required evidence, credentials_required, reversible-as-applicable, and resolution_class RESOLUTION_OPERATOR_ATTESTED. Trigger semantics pinned: the trigger is a static catalog field (trigger_condition text, e.g. multi-operator need) that is un-met by default and met ONLY via an operator-attested integration-evidence record - never inferred from live environment state. Credential semantics pinned: credential presence is a presence-only check of declared env-var NAMES (values never read into item fields, no network probes), so the whole feature is provable offline with fixtures. Items never execute anything in-repo. Verified by fixture tests through the provider seam. Band semantics pinned: using the SHIPPED band vocabulary (needs_action/advisory/info/ready): a gated item whose trigger_condition is un-met renders as info with a not-yet-needed label (visible, never hidden, never needs_action); trigger-met-but-credentials-absent renders as advisory with copy naming the missing credential env-var names (waiting on provisioning); trigger-met-with-credentials renders as needs_action (ready for the operator to execute). Fixture tests cover all three states.

evidence.notes: Band semantics for the three gated Firebase rows (firebase-creds, firebase-deploy, firebase-realtime-smoke) proven through the provide_integration_actions provider seam across all THREE states: trigger un-met -> info (not-yet-needed, always rendered, never hidden); trigger-met-creds-absent -> advisory naming the missing FIREBASE_TOKEN env-var NAME; trigger-met-creds-present -> needs_action. Trigger is met ONLY via an operator-attested evidence record (firebase-trigger action id), never inferred from live env (env creds alone keep the row at info). Presence-only env-var NAME check: a set value never surfaces in any item field or to_dict serialization (no-secret-leak). Items carry exact_command=None + operator_command (honest-commands), resolution_class=RESOLUTION_OPERATOR_ATTESTED, automatable=False (never executes). Passed action evidence suppresses the action item (F004 status item takes over). Offline fixtures only. Provider logic shipped in F001; this feature is its fixture proof.

features.description: Integration status surfacing: per-integration status (configured / deployed / smoke-passing / pending) derived from the catalog + captured evidence and routed through the SHIPPED action surfaces (what-now-logic bands, render-gate, operator console action items) - no separate integrations panel; the new work is the status derivation feeding those surfaces, so the operator sees integration readiness at a glance rather than via command archaeology.
steps: Implement the status matrix exactly as pinned in plan.md, deriving the floor from the append-only evidence history
Route status through the existing surfaces: pending integrations in the needs-action band, cleared integrations visible in the quiet band with status labels
Pending items link to their F001 ActionItem; clears_when consumes the F002 evidence files
Test: each matrix row + the failed-after-passed floor case + post-clear quiet-band visibility, through the real producer-to-render path; no secret leak
features.acceptance: Per-integration status is derived EXCLUSIVELY from the catalog + the append-only evidence history via the pinned status matrix in plan.md (evidence files are the sole status driver; env-var presence is a display hint on item copy and never advances status): the status floor is the highest status achieved by passed records, a later failed record surfaces a failure flag in the item copy WITHOUT regressing the floor, and each matrix row is exercised by fixtures. Post-clear visibility pinned mechanically against the shipped clears_when suppression model: each integration emits TWO items - the pending ACTION item (clears and suppresses normally via clears_when) and a separate informational STATUS item (audience=operator, band info, always rendered, carrying the derived status label); only genuinely pending integrations' action items occupy the needs_action band, and the info status item is what keeps cleared integrations visible; pending integrations link to their ActionItem (dedupe_key stable across rebuilds); resolution happens via the registered integration_evidence_present predicate reading the same evidence files F002 writes - no hand-editing; rendering leaks no secrets. Verified by tests through the real producer-to-render path per the operator-outcome QA sufficiency contract. End-to-end completion journey pinned: one test executes the rendered static-dashboard ActionItem's actual exact_command (the real smoke), which writes evidence through the F002 writer, then re-runs the real provider-to-render rebuild and asserts that integration's status flipped and its pending item cleared - no hand-editing anywhere in the loop.

evidence.notes: derive_integration_status() in integration_actions.py implements the plan.md status matrix EXCLUSIVELY from the append-only evidence history (env-var presence never advances status): per-integration floor = highest status proven by passed records (pending<configured<deployed<smoke-passing), realtime 'configured' cross-derives from the deploy integration reaching deployed; a later failed record raises failure_flag WITHOUT regressing the floor. provide_integration_status_items() in operator_console.py emits one ALWAYS-rendered info-band STATUS item per integration (distinct id namespace integration-status:<id>, clears_when=None so never suppressed, exact_command=None/automatable=False), the sibling to the pending ACTION item — it keeps CLEARED integrations visible with their derived label. dashboard._gather_action_items concatenates action+status items.
